detail.longDescription: 🤖 Ongoing supply-chain attack: attackers hijacked high-profile open-source maintainer accounts to plant credential-stealing GitHub Actions workflows in 340+ repos — incl. the 18.4k-star pyxel game engine. Malicious workflow pushed to 27 repos in minutes (StepSecurity). 🔗 https:// thehackernews.com/2026/10/cred ential-stealing-github-actions.html # SupplyChain # InfoSec # GitHub # CyberSec
